page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin (references and section marks beside the lines); running head at top; a marginal note "41. De dage" at lower left beside the final lines; catchword "di-" at the foot right.

main_text.p: erant, quique præditi erant Spiritu Christi eos regente, illuminante, docente quid in Deo miserante, quid in hominibus ægris, quomodo cum unoquoque agendum ut obstacula in eis occulta viisque Dei opposita removeantur, nemo esset qui solidam hanc Theologiam propagare atque communicare posset vel audereteam: cumque initio solidi hi Theologi auditores reperirent bene dispositos, hoc est, desiderio, sinceritate & simplicitate insignes, paratosque qui se totos in Deum, in crucem, inque regimen ejus candide projicerent, tantos faciebant in illa propagarda progressus, ut ob nonnulla unius Petri verba, mox (a) ter, mox quinquies mille (a) A&. 2:41. & cap. 4: 4homines ad eorum sodalitatem accederent.

Non exigebat pia eorum simplicitas rationcinationes ullasve argumentatiunculas, non rhetorices lenocinia, non futilis criticces praecisas morositates. Sola (b) lex Domini immaculata, convertens animas, testimonium unum Domini fidele, sapientiam praestans parvulis, praeceptum Domini lucidum illuminans oculos, praeceptum magnum, Amoris hominis interni ad Deum, crucifixionis & abnegationis hominis externi & ratiocinantis, simplicissimis verbis propositum, illos, desideriis ad Spiritum Dei directis, sic convertebat ut Spiritu, sapientia, lumine Dei supremæ facultates implerentur, infimæ & activæ a voluptatibus & erroribus præservarentur, nec non sic custodirentur, ut ad finem usque possent perfecte conservari.

page.notes: Left margin notes: "(a) A&. 2:41. & cap. 4: 4" and "(b) Pf. 19: &c." are partly reconstructed; the bottom-left marginal note "41. De dage" is faint and uncertain. The running head and catchword "di-" are as read.
